parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a photon.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
A stationary nucleus of samarium-157 ($^{157}_{62}\text{Sm}$) emits a gamma-ray ($\gamma$-ray) photon of energy $0.57\text{ MeV}$.

Determine, for one $\gamma$-ray photon:

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Using your answer to (b)(ii), determine the speed of the samarium-157 nucleus after emission of the photon.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: By reference to your answer in (c)(i), explain quantitatively why the speed of the samarium-157 nucleus may be assumed to be negligible compared with the speed of the photon.
